scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title song before the live Star Night red-carpet broadcast begins.

scenes.title: Red Carpet Commentary Clash
scenes.summary: Crew members hurry Bu Xiaogu past cheering fan clubs at the Star Night red carpet while host Wen Simo tries to calm two commentators arguing on air and reporter Bianbian chases the drama.

scenes.title: Short-Staffed in Hospital
scenes.summary: After Chun Yuqiao defends Unit One's exhausting overtime and collapses with acute stomach pain, he and hospitalised producer Kaiwen agree with Xingzi that the chief editor's office urgently needs temporary help.
scenes.location: Studio One backstage and hospital ward

scenes.title: Seconded From Administration
scenes.summary: When the chief editor's office temporarily transfers Bu Xiaogu out of administration, Xiaoye teases her for pretending not to be thrilled as Xiaogu waves goodbye to her admin desk.

scenes.title: Demanding a Public Apology
scenes.summary: Reporting for overtime in Unit One, Bu Xiaogu gets a rapid briefing from Xingzi on the gala's high ratings and her first assignment: getting the two quarrelling commentators to apologise publicly.

scenes.title: Xingzi's Pink Fan-Club Notebook
scenes.summary: Xingzi explains the influence of Xin Huimei's wealthy fan-club president and lends Bu Xiaogu her secret pink notebook of celebrity fan-club contacts.

scenes.title: Refusing to Apologise
scenes.summary: Both red-carpet commentators flatly refuse to apologise on air unless the other apologises privately first.

scenes.title: A Formal Apology From Chun Yuqiao
scenes.summary: While Bu Xiaogu vents to Xingzi about the two stubborn commentators, Chun Yuqiao walks up behind her and surprises Xiaogu with a formal apology for speaking harshly to her before.

scenes.title: The Wrong Bottled Water
scenes.summary: Xingzi spots the wrong sponsor's bottled water in a viral backstage video uploaded by Xin Huimei's fan club and sends Bu Xiaogu to negotiate with the fan-club president.

scenes.title: Asking to Pull the Fan Video
scenes.summary: Meeting Xin Huimei's fan-club president, Bu Xiaogu explains the sponsor loophole in the fan video and offers professional television production resources in exchange for taking it down.

scenes.title: One Day to Prove Our Show Is Better
scenes.summary: Learning that Xin Huimei and her fan club booked rival network ME's talk show hosted by Luo Lin, Bu Xiaogu alerts Xingzi by phone and wins twenty-four hours to pitch Xingtian's own talk show instead.

scenes.title: Satisfying Both Bosses at Once
scenes.summary: Knowing Chun Yuqiao would never trade show resources to shield himself from gossip, Xingzi and Bu Xiaogu agree Xiaogu must draft a proposal strong enough to satisfy both the fan club and Yuqiao.

scenes.title: Twenty-Something Questions for Chun Yuqiao
scenes.summary: After Xingzi updates Chun Yuqiao on the commentators, Bu Xiaogu asks permission to seek Yuqiao's production advice and returns the next morning with over twenty tough revision points.
scenes.location: Xingtian corridor and Chun Yuqiao's office

scenes.title: Becoming the Boss's Apprentice
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao puts off signing urgent contracts to coach Bu Xiaogu through every revision, prompting Xingzi to congratulate Xiaogu on becoming Yuqiao's personal apprentice.

scenes.title: A Chess Match Behind the Scenes
scenes.summary: Impressed by the revised proposal, the fan-club president cancels rival network ME's booking and compares the revisions to sparring with a hidden master before Bu Xiaogu reports victory to Xingzi.

scenes.title: Barred From the Pitch Meeting
scenes.summary: When Xingzi presents Bu Xiaogu's Xin Huimei charity talk-show plan, Chun Yuqiao suspects a backroom trade and bars the administrative assistant from entering the pitch meeting.

scenes.title: Six Years Studying Production
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu chases Chun Yuqiao outside to plead for her six-year dream of becoming a producer; moved that she cares more about her craft than past unfair blame, Yuqiao grants her a fair pitch.

scenes.title: Winning the Charity Show Pitch
scenes.summary: Competing fairly against Unit Two at the pitch meeting, Bu Xiaogu presents a practical charity-matching format for Xin Huimei's fund and wins Chun Yuqiao's approval to launch the revamped show.

scenes.title: Blacklisting the Staged Feud
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao sees right through Xingzi and Xiaogu's effort to shield him from rival TV gossip, defends Xiaogu's proposal on merit, and bans the two commentators after learning they staged their feud with Bianbian.

scenes.title: My First Approved Proposal
scenes.summary: Watching host Wen Simo welcome Xin Huimei's fan-club president onstage for the taping, Bu Xiaogu reflects on completing her very first television proposal and seeing Chun Yuqiao's truer side.

scenes.title: Fuming Over the Studio Snub
scenes.summary: A rival Xingtian executive complains bitterly on the phone after losing the studio pitch to an administrative assistant.

scenes.title: Different Commentaries on One Classic
scenes.summary: Unpacking a heavy parcel of books for Chun Yuqiao, Bu Xiaogu discovers dozens of annotated editions of the same classic text and jokes that commentators overthink everything.

scenes.title: Staying On in the Chief Editor's Office
scenes.summary: When Kaiwen recovers and Bu Xiaogu expects to return to administration, Chun Yuqiao refuses to poach other units' producers and keeps Xiaogu on in the chief editor's office instead.

scenes.title: A Toast With Tea to a New Agency
scenes.summary: Over tea with fellow singer Bai Yang after leaving Yuanye Records, Xin Huimei jokes about enjoying life without an agency before revealing she is about to sign with a top management firm.

scenes.title: Waiting for Disgruntled Guests
scenes.summary: Rival executives inside Xingtian look for outside pretexts and decide to wait for the two blacklisted commentators to stir up trouble against Chun Yuqiao.

scenes.title: You Were the One Who Betrayed Him?
scenes.summary: Having drinks with Luo Lin, Xin Huimei criticises Chun Yuqiao's arrogance until Luo Lin lets slip that Yuqiao accused her of betraying him first, leaving Huimei stunned.
